title: Primitive completeness C1 (literal layer): \x/\r/\0 + \xNN string escapes, char literals, hex/binary int literals, negative literals

comments.author: Yffe
comments.content: Cluster 1 gap 1 (string escapes) ONLY this commit. lex_string escape table extended: \r->13, \0->0, \xNN->byte (0x00..=0x7F byte-faithful per the v1 byte char model); unknown/malformed/high-byte escapes are structured SyntaxError (recover past close-quote), never the old silent 'other as char' swallow, never a panic. No new Expr/Token variant — decoded byte flows through existing Expr::StrLit byte-push lowering, so no workspace match-arm churn and no skill arm. 07-strings.md gains REQ-6 (escape table; on-manifest). Gaps 2/3 (char + hex/binary int literals) STOPPED+REPORTED: they add lexer token grammar that lexer.md REQ-1 ('no char tokens') / REQ-3 ('int = ASCII-digit run') forbid -> need a .design/syntax/lexer.md amendment (acto-doc-author); lexer.md is NOT on the cluster-1 manifest. MANIFEST EXPANSION requested per R-SPEC-4. Gap 4 (negative literals) deferred to the signed-int cluster: no signed PrimType exists (U32/U64/Usize/Bool only), so a negative literal has no sound typed home in v1. Verified: \x1b==27 / \r==13 / \0==0 at L3 (real verus, non-vacuous via result==(n==CODE)); wrong-code NOT L3. Workspace 553 passed/0 failed; clippy/fmt clean. NOT pushed, NOT closed (critic re-audits).

comments.author: Yffe
comments.content: SHIPPED + critic-clean (55824ec). String escapes \r/\0/\xNN (ASCII; high-byte deferred). \x1b->27 L3. Char/hex/binary literals + integer operators folded into #92.
